description: Evaluation harness for the Context Engineering retrieval skill: pytest-based POC that sends versioned test cases through a knowledge-retrieval skill, validates deterministic contracts, and scores results with IR metrics and an optional LLM judge.

servicesDescription.harness: Test harness: agent/skill runner, MCP and REST transports, deterministic validators, ranking metrics, LLM-judge runner
